picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, unveiled at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, aims to link the department's supercomputers, scientific datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified national AI-for-discovery infrastructure — a rare federal-level bet on AI accelerating basic science.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic alliance with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions is a landmark fusion of frontier AI and fundamental physics, with potential to reshape how collider data is analyzed worldwide.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 14+ universities, including Vanderbilt, to build shared advanced computing infrastructure signals growing federal coordination of academic AI compute capacity — a significant policy move with long-term research implications.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claimed analytic proof of a finite-time singularity for the Navier-Stokes equations, if validated, would be a historic AI-assisted contribution toward one of math's seven Millennium Prize Problems.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federally funded, multi-institution project centered at Brown to study protein misfolding in neurodegenerative disease, incorporating machine learning, represents a substantial public investment in AI-driven biomedical research.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5 million NIA renewal for UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham's MassAITC sustains a major center applying AI to connected care for aging and Alzheimer's disease, underscoring continued federal commitment to health AI.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: Purdue and Google Public Sector's summit on physical AI in manufacturing builds on a deepening multiyear industry-academia partnership spanning cloud infrastructure and workforce development, illustrating how AI is being pushed into industrial production.
picks.title: Purdue-Google summit advances physical AI, manufacturing and workforce readiness

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model, which predicts protein motion dramatically faster than traditional molecular dynamics simulations, could meaningfully accelerate structural biology and drug discovery research.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $1.6 million award to the University of Cape Town for AI-driven mapping of genetic variants affecting drug metabolism in African patients is a notable example of AI-for-science funding targeting underrepresented global health research.
picks.title: Google grant boosts UCT's AI-driven scientific breakthroughs

picks.editorial_note: A joint MIT, CMU, NYU, and Stanford team built an AI system that beat top human players at Stratego, a landmark result in imperfect-information game AI with implications for strategic reasoning under uncertainty.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego
